notes.title: V3.0 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Radar can show chicken claws ( important hint).
[*]Wearing the wig allows you to use Mountain Pusher.
[/olist]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Automatically saved after the main event.
[*]Fix bug with auto-save when teleporting through caves.
[*]Add tips about telescope operation.
[*]Add a tip about the disposable ｍass gainer.
[*]The dialog UI displays button.
[*]Improve the guidance in the early stage of the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: V2.10 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Auto save feature.
[*]Telescope prop.
[/olist]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Improvement of calculation for cannon firing.
[*]Increase the probability of rare props in the blind box store.
[*]Bamboo Dragonfly and Slipper are no longer disposable.
[*]Retain the props being used when transforming (except disposable props).
[*]Improve the guidance in the early stage of the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: 10.13 Hotfix
notes.content:
1. Character dialog touched up.
2. Terrain improvement.
3. Fix the bug when the chick falls into the water.

notes.title: Beta V2.3 Update
notes.content:
Mainly terrain fixes, icon beautification, bug fixes and experience improvements.
Removed as much jaggies as possible from the terrain.
Made official icons for some props.

Fixed the following bugs:
1. Early completion of Monopoly achievement.
2. Characters would get stuck in some corners.

Made the following improvements:
1. Save data show time.
2. No muscle durability consumption in the basketball court.
